items.title: First-Time Buyers Look to Upcoming Budget Amid Rising Mortgage Rates
items.summary: According to BBC, aspiring homeowners face mounting affordability hurdles as average five-year fixed mortgage rates reach 6%, prompting calls for targeted government support.

items.title: Lockton Appoints Russell Smith as US Property and Casualty Claims Leader
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, independent insurance broker Lockton has strengthened its leadership team with the appointment of a former Sompo executive.

items.title: Prime Minister Faces Makerfield Test Ahead of the Autumn Budget
items.summary: According to BBC, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham approaches his first 100 days in office, residents in his former constituency of Makerfield await the upcoming Budget to see if government policies will ease cost-of-living pressures.

items.title: Surrey Residents and Businesses Voice Cost-of-Living Pressures Ahead of Budget
items.summary: According to BBC, as Chancellor John Healey prepares his first budget, people and business owners in affluent Surrey speak out about high living costs and financial strain.

items.title: Selective Insurance Appoints Jacob E. Rothfuss as Standard Lines President
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, the New Jersey-based insurer has recruited the Velocity CEO to lead its standard commercial and personal lines businesses.

items.title: Ransomware Incidents Surge by Over 50 Percent in the Third Quarter
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, according to threat exposure management platform NordLayer, global ransomware attacks reached a record high in Q3 2026, driven by new threat groups and changing tactics.
